data.change_summary: Clarified the VS-01 validation reference so biofilter maturity is explicitly observability-only in both the scenario narrative and report template, removed the hidden `0.01` molt-cadence fallback so `temp_condition_min_factor = 0.0` now truly freezes molt timer/readiness progress, gated critical-GH molt-failure diagnostics behind enabled GH minimums, and added regression tests for both shrimp edge cases.
outstanding_risks: The executable VS-01 validation-suite probe still prints `maturity=...` in its observed summary as an observability field; any future calibration/report workflow should keep that field clearly labeled non-scoring if it is retained.

VS-03 still passes at the model's current upper pH storage bound (`light_max_pH=8.500`), so future carbonate or photosynthesis retuning may require re-centering that scenario to avoid ceiling-dominated behavior.
I ran targeted validation and shrimp regressions, not the full workspace test matrix.

steps.description: Inspected the pending amendments in the validation document and shrimp molt system to confirm where the stale maturity field, hidden cadence floor, and bogus critical-GH diagnostic were still present.
Updated `docs/validation_scenarios.md` so the cycling scenario and report template treat biofilter maturity as observability-only rather than a scored checkpoint field.

Patched `crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs` so an explicit zero temperature cadence floor freezes molt progression instead of silently advancing via an epsilon fallback, and so critical-GH failure details are only emitted when `gh_min_d` is enabled.
Added shrimp regression coverage for zero cadence-floor freezing and disabled-GH diagnostic behavior, then reran targeted validation and shrimp test suites.

validation_evidence: `cargo test -p tank_core --test molt_mineral_budget` passed with `25 passed; 0 failed`, including the new `test_zero_temp_condition_min_factor_freezes_molt_progress` and `test_disabled_gh_min_omits_critical_gh_ratio_detail` regressions.
`cargo test -p tank_core --test validation step_hours_accepts_zero_temp_condition_min_factor -- --nocapture` passed, confirming zero remains a valid runtime value for `temp_condition_min_factor`.

`cargo test --test e2e_validation_suite validation_suite_summary -- --nocapture` passed with `SUMMARY: 8/8 scenarios passed`; VS-01 still passed on chemistry outputs (`week8: TAN=1.067 NO2=0.002 NO3=7.879 pH=8.500`) while maturity remained observational.
`git diff --check -- docs/validation_scenarios.md crates/tank_core/src/systems/shrimp.rs crates/tank_core/tests/molt_mineral_budget.rs` passed with no whitespace or patch-format issues.
